title: Skills
sub: A short description is always in context; the model chooses one and the body loads only then.

steps.d:
"Is the DW-480 drain pump covered under warranty,
and for how long?"

steps.h: Your code lists what's always in context: names and one-line descriptions only
steps.d:
warranty-checklist: use when a question asks whether
something is covered, or for how long.
unit-conversion: use for measurement conversions.
citation-style: use for how to cite a source.

steps.h: The model chooses a skill to load
Your code loads that skill's full body into context; the other two stay unloaded
steps.d:
"1. State the warranty length that applies.
2. Check whether anything voids it.
3. Say plainly whether it is covered."

steps.h: The model answers, following the loaded skill
steps.d:
"Covered: the 2-year full warranty applies, and
nothing about this case voids it."
